description.narrative: 'This project addresses weak transparency of money in elections and politics that prevents a level playing field for women candidates and enables undue influence in policy mak-ing, both globally and in six countries -namely Indonesia, Madagascar, Panama, Sri Lanka, Venezuela and Zambia. We will (i) generate sustained public demand for transparency of money in politics and overcoming fi-nancial barriers faced by women politicians; (ii) facilitate political engagement towards reform for greater transparency, integrity and equality in political finance regimes, and (iii) develop innovations for monitoring and implementing them. The methodology allows for country-specific adaptation, prioritisation, sequencing and peer-to-peer learning across borders. Value of the contract is CA$2,080,727

participating-org.narrative: Canada - Global Affairs Canada | Affaires mondiales Canada

recipient-region.narrative: This project is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany. The countries involved are Indonesia, Madagascar, Panama, Sri Lanka, Venezuela and Zambia.
